trace_interpretation: Fresh serial compiler traces identify frontend/backend and optimizer work. Instrumented diagnostic times are separate from uninstrumented paired compiles; nested totals must not be added together. Clang 21 async Source begin/end events are paired before summarizing. Pilot runs preceded a formatting-only adjustment to the helper calls; final paired probes use the saved final header bytes.
paired_compile_method: One ABBA then one BAAB block per source (before, after, after, before, after, before, before, after), serial on CPU 2, four observations/version/source. Each variant uses a stable overlay containing only kin/ecs/component.hpp ahead of the same repository includes, matching target PCH and normal -O2. The PCH contains standard/Flecs headers, not the component header. Canonical sources and PCH remain untouched. Dependency files assert that both registration sources consume the selected overlay and core/json.cpp does not. No time-trace instrumentation. core/json.cpp is an unchanged control.

allocation_and_runtime_probe.method: Clang -O2 with assertions; one private probe component registers 1,000 integer fields of the same member. Count global C++ operator new calls/bytes during field registration only, excluding world/type creation. Then visit 1,000,000 integer fields per measured sample: 3 warmups and 10 measured samples/process, 3 processes/version, pinned CPU 2. Direct/nested/string patches and checksum are asserted. This is a synthetic callback probe, not a full-game FPS measurement.
allocation_and_runtime_probe.allocation_interpretation: On this libstdc++ configuration, eliminating the intermediate layer removes two allocations and 64 bytes per direct integer field. The remaining 22 allocations include registration vector growth. The allocation count is not total process memory or all allocation APIs; small-buffer behavior may differ on other libraries.

mechanical_checks.change: Direct fields keep projection lambdas typed until their final registry std::function; custom properties retain supplied std::function inputs.

measurement_parser_corrections.issue: The successful baseline build included one C object, but the first assertion only counted C++ actions.
measurement_parser_corrections.remedy: Accept C and CXX actions; recover all 221 compile outputs and 232 action records by matching the successful stdout outputs to the latest Ninja-log entry for each. Keep original timing; no replacement sample. End load was unavailable and is explicitly null.

measurement_parser_corrections.issue: Clang 21 Source trace events can use async begin/end without a dur field.
measurement_parser_corrections.remedy: Pair matching begin/end events and reuse the completed trace. The recovered first trace has unavailable start load explicitly null. No recompile or sample discarded.

limits: Third-party compilation and shader generation were prebuilt; this is not a from-scratch dependency/toolchain build.
No agent-owned validation compilers overlapped timed builds; external processes were not controlled. Header writes, CMake configuration, Ninja-log compaction and compilation were serialized.
Whole-build observations remain exploratory; paired file probes and the unchanged control give a more focused comparison. No cumulative speedup over the start of the optimization project is inferred.
No Windows/MSVC or full native desktop/3D/GPU runtime validation. Optional 3D checks cover syntax/template compilation only.
